_comment: Film 79 sound plan, read by mix.py. Sparse on purpose: the voice and the clips carry the film. Anchors = script phrases (words of timing.json), dt in seconds from the word's start (at='end': from its end). rel = dB against the voice's speaking level; beds are looped, faded and ducked like the music; hits are peak-matched. File sources: sfx-bibliothek (dc, chime) and Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 2 samples each, 2026-11-25, seeds in sfx_prompts.json), trims in 'trim'.

beds.what: hum of the data centre (tower behind the fence, hook)
the gliding empty cars (the road full of crates)
beds.to: from one machine to the next

beds.what: the data centre: no windows, staff of zero
beds.to: Listen to where he found it

beds.what: the tower shines on while the kitchen is dark
beds.from: Behind the fence, the tower shines

hits.what: an empty car slows down and drives on
the kitchen goes dark: one relay click
noon: every phone chimes at once
noon: a soft glass chime under it
the clock is wound again (after the last word)
hits.word: Somebody still has to show up

mutes.what: the kitchen goes dark: music and beds drop out, then slowly return

trim.relay: relay_a.mp3 cut 1.25-2.35 s (one click at ~0.15 s, the 2nd click of the sample is cut off)
